items.title: What Does Aon (AON) Expanding Client Treaty Capacity To 35% Mean?
items.summary: Aon (NYSE:AON) expanded its Aon Client Treaty facility for 2027, lifting co-insurance capacity to 35% from 28.5%. The enlarged facility is backed by partners including QBE and multiple Lloyd's syndicates, supporting larger committed reinsurance lines. Management describes the expanded Aon Client Treaty as a material investment in broking innovation and risk capital efficiency for clients.
